Container.Name: twobells
Container.Overview: The departures dashboard for your station and bus stops in Great Britain, with its settings site at /settings. For the home network only: never forward its port. Repository must name a release's version: the one you checked with cosign. Before the first start, give the appdata folder to the container's user: chown 10001:10001 /mnt/user/appdata/twobells and chmod 700 it. Keys go in the settings.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: The dashboard at / and the settings at /settings. Home network only. Keep the 0.0.0.0: (IPv4 only), or IPv6 visitors look to the app as if they were on the home network.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Saved settings, keys, the settings password, the bus timetable and history. Must be owned by uid 10001 (chown 10001:10001).
